 Trade Deadline Buzz: Vita Vea, Derrick Brown, Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
 By Wyatt Grindley - November 8, 2026 
 Buccaneers 
 The Athletic’s Jonathan Jones says the Buccaneers probably wouldn’t turn down a first-round pick for DT Vita Vea , but he also doubts any team would offer that, even though Tampa Bay has gotten calls on Vea. 
 Falcons 
 Sports Illustrated’s Albert Breer said Friday the Falcons aren’t looking to be buyers at the trade deadline even though they’re in the mix in the NFC South. They would, though, trade LB  Christian Harris  or CB  Mike Hughes .
 Panthers 
 Sports Illustrated’s Albert Breer mentions Panthers DT Bobby Brown III as a potential trade candidate in his Friday notebook, as defensive tackle is a spot multiple contending teams want to fortify. 
 Panthers DT Derrick Brown has also come up, but Breer notes Carolina’s not actively trying to move him, and he’d be super expensive. 
 Breer adds Carolina probably won’t be buyers at the trade deadline, and they’ve at least done homework on what selling some veterans would look like. 
 NFL Media’s Mike Garafolo notes that the Week 9 loss to the Broncos might influence how willing the 3-5 Panthers are to trade away players before the deadline. 
 Saints 
 Sports Illustrated’s Albert Breer wrote Friday that Saints DTs Davon Godchaux and Nathan Shepherd had popped up as potential trade candidates, with several teams interested in adding at the position. He added that LB Pete Werner also popped up as a trade candidate. 
 The Athletic’s Jonathan Jones has heard the Saints could deal a cheap veteran or two.
